parts.t: Neighbourhood guide · City of Surrey · Guildford

Guildford is an MLS® area in North Surrey, east of City Centre. The City’s Guildford Plan covers about 515 hectares from 140 Street east to the Highway 1 interchange at 160 Street, roughly between 100 Avenue and 108 Avenue.
The MLS® area is not the same as the plan area. On the MLS® map, it runs east from about 144 Street toward Fraser Heights, with its south edge around 96 Avenue.

Written by Jared Gibbons, REALTOR®, Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, on October 13, 2026. I have worked in Fraser Valley real estate for 11+ years. Facts come from the official sources noted on this page. Rules and boundaries change, so confirm anything important with the City of Surrey and Surrey Schools.
Not legal, planning or financial advice. Confirm zoning, plan designations and school catchments before you buy or sell.

From MLS® sales data (not an official source): the median lot size of detached houses sold from July 1 to October 8, 2026 was 7,257 square feet, across 11 sales with a recorded lot size.
The Guildford Plan got final approval on October 30, 2023, and guides growth over the next 30 to 50 years. It has three parts: Guildford Centre, the Hawthorne District and the Headwaters District.
The plan was first drawn up around a light rail line on 104 Avenue. The City says that project was suspended in November 2018.
